title: Pentagon will not livestream execution of Fort Hood shooter: Trump
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump, after bipartisan backlash, says the Pentagon won't livestream the firing squad execution of the Fort Hood shooter after all.

image.caption: A military memorial for fallen soldiers is displayed prior to a memorial ceremony for shooting victims on April 9, 2014, in Fort Hood, Texas. (Eric Gay/The Associated Press)

blocks.text: U.S. President Donald Trump, after bipartisan backlash, says the Pentagon won't livestream the firing squad execution of the Fort Hood shooter after all.
U.S. president made the announcement on social media
He made the announcement on Truth Social Thursday morning.
